messages:
pagerbot: Pager: spike in 502/504s from api-gateway-eu-west (ingress). Alert threshold crossed (5m error rate > 12%). Paging oncall.
maria.sre: I'm oncall. looking at metrics now — dashboards show 502s concentrated on /v1/generate and /v1/chat endpoints, 10s lat tail also up.
ryan-platform: seeing a sharp rise in upstream 504s from inference-cluster-1 per traces. latency to backend GPUs increased.
maria.sre: curl to edge LB returns 502 intermittently: `HTTP/1.1 502 Bad Gateway` (sample).
ashok.infra: checking ingress proxies: `kubectl get h2-proxy -n ingress` shows some pods RESTARTING, CPU spike on node eu-west-2.
sylvia-support: CS: multiple customers reporting failures for model inference calls and degraded UX. (4 active tickets so far)
maria.sre: I'm toggling ingress quick-metrics: `sum(rate(http_requests_total{status=~"5..",job="api-gateway"}[1m])) by (route)` shows /v1/generate is ~65% of 5xx.
ryan-platform: Can we route traffic to secondary gateway cluster (api-gateway-eu-west-b) as fallback? capacity is available.
ashok.infra: We have a config flag for region fallback. Propose enabling region-fallback-policy: `set-router fallback=eu-west-b` for canary first.
maria.sre: Good. Before global flip — let's enable circuit-breaker on heavy routes to reduce concurrent upstream connections: `ingressctl set cb /v1/generate max-conns=50`.
deploy-bot: Deploy bot: recent canary `api-gateway@2026.03.10-2210` rolled 30m ago. No heavy errors reported at deploy time.
ryan-platform: Noting: tail traces show a small subset of clients sending very large request bodies, keeping connections open — could be conn pool exhaustion.
sylvia-support: Adding client-impact note: estimated 6% of requests returning 502/504 are from top 10 customers. CS notified enterprise owners.
maria.sre: Action plan: 1) enable fallback routing to eu-west-b canary 2) apply CB limits on /v1/generate and /v1/chat 3) throttle large payloads via ingress filter 4) scale connection pool on upstream if safe.
ashok.infra: Initiating fallback to eu-west-b for 10% traffic now: `router weight api-gateway:eu-west-b=10%`.
maria.sre: Applying CB: `ingressctl set cb /v1/generate max-conns=50 max-rt=4s` — done.
ashok.infra: Enabled request-size limit filter: `ingressctl set filter req-size 1MB` — will drop abnormally large payloads (returns 413) to protect pools.
ryan-platform: Scaling upstream pools: bumped inference-cluster-1 connection pool from 500->800, will monitor.
maria.sre: After initial changes error rate dropping from 18% -> 9% on /v1/generate (5m window). Good signal.
sylvia-support: Noted in incident channel and updated CS: partial mitigation in place, still monitoring.
ashok.infra: Increasing fallback weight to 40% to give relief: `router weight api-gateway:eu-west-b=40%`.
maria.sre: Metrics now ~5% 5xx across region, tail lat ~400ms reduced. Keeping CB and req-size filters for now.
ryan-platform: Root cause hypothesis: connection pool exhaustion caused by a combination of large payloads + recent canary with slightly higher per-request latency.
maria.sre: We're going to keep routing fallback and filters until upstream patch lands. I'll open a rollback ticket for the canary if needed, but current canary rollback not performed yet.
sylvia-support: Customer comms drafted — ETA 30m for full stabilization. Notifying affected customers.
incident-bot: Incident declared P1. Oncall: `maria.sre`. Pager duty escalations set. Postmortem owner requested.
maria.sre: Handoff to ashok for infra-level remediation (pool tuning + node reprovision) — I'll continue to monitor and coordinate with CS. Ashok do you accept?
ashok.infra: Accepting handoff. Will reprovision 2 nodes to relieve CPU pressure and push a backend patch to reduce per-request latency. ETA 20-25m.
ryan-platform: I'll work with the deployment team to prepare rollback if side-by-side metrics degrade after infra changes.
maria.sre: Thanks all. We'll reconvene in 15m for status. Please add short updates in this thread only. :thumbsup:
